definitions.explanation: Colloquial form of いろいろな. Used to describe many different kinds.

examples.japanese: {色|いろ}んな⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: This shop has various kinds of bread.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{色|いろ}んな⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I was interested in all sorts of things.

notes:
{色|いろ}んな is a colloquial contraction of ⟦いろいろな→色々：02352_iroiro⟧ (various). Extremely common in spoken Japanese.

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- ⟦いろいろな→色々：02352_iroiro⟧: standard/formal (writing, polite speech)
- {色|いろ}んな: casual/colloquial (conversation, informal writing)
- いろんな: same word without kanji (also common)

COMMON PATTERNS:
{色|いろ}んな is a pre-noun modifier only. It always precedes a noun and cannot be used as a predicate. Use ⟦いろいろ→色々：02352_iroiro⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ for the predicative form.
- {色|いろ}んな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: various people ✓
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{色|いろ}んなだ: ✗ (use ⟦いろいろ→色々：02352_iroiro⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ instead)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色|いろ}んな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: various people
- {色|いろ}んな⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: various places
- {色|いろ}んな⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in various senses
- {色|いろ}んな⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: all sorts of things happen

cross_references.note: standard form; いろいろな is the formal/written equivalent
